title: Morton's wives and the singer Edmonia Henderson
summary: How many wives Morton had, doubts about his marriage to Mabel, and a woman singer who recorded with him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, how many wives did he have? Just two?

Well, as far as I know, that's all. Still, he had another girl there at one time that made some records with him according to Hulseiser. Ken Hulseiser. Ken Hulseiser. I don't know whether it was Henderson or who it was. Made records with him. Yeah, she made a few records. The singer, so I didn't know.
Rosa Henderson or some other thing. What was that Henderson?

Were they issued? Yeah, I think they were issued. I think there were a couple of missions. But anyhow, he went through the marriage ceremony with Mabel. At least he says so, and I'm inclined to believe her, but it may have been a fake. I hate to say it, but I tried to locate the jurisdiction where it happened, but I was unable to. Well, I know who that was. I suppose that was Fussy Mabel then, huh? She was probably Fussy Mabel. Who was that? Ed Monia Henderson. I guess that probably was Ed. Is that right? Let me see this.
Made Georgia grind and some other two teams. All along, Bo Caddium.
Well, I got about a half a dozen of those pieces that you were listing there. I guess that's about the best I can do, though.
Well, that's pretty good. You got that one. And I put about eight or ten on there, so.
Well, there's more than that. Yeah, maybe. But it's kind of a hard job.
